title: Base ref taken from the PR payload reaches git argv unvalidated
body: `base_ref` is read from the webhook payload and interpolated into `git diff origin/<base>...HEAD`. A crafted branch name starting with `-` is parsed as a git option. Validate the ref against the repository's branch list or reject names that do not match the ref-name grammar before building argv.

checks.note: argv built from base_ref without a ref-name check
value originates from the PR payload in main()
SECURITY.md states SHA arguments come from trusted sources; branch names are not covered

verification.reason: Anchor read at head confirms unvalidated interpolation; a leading-dash ref name reproduces the option-injection shape; no guard found in callers.
